name: Isabella 'IronVanguard' Vance
biography:
Isabella 'IronVanguard' Vance graduated at the top of her class from the Security Consortium's military academy and was fast-tracked into a prestigious command position. She served with distinction for ten years, earning commendations and promotions, until the day she was ordered to fire on a transport full of civilian refugees because it might have been carrying supplies for rebels. Isabella refused, her unit refused with her, and the Security Consortium responded by disbanding the unit and blacklisting all of them from service. Rather than accept the dishonorable discharge, Isabella formed her own mercenary company—calling it the Iron Vanguard—and dedicated herself to protecting the people the so-called legitimate military wouldn't. Her reputation for reliability and honor spread quickly, and she became the first call for anyone needing protection in dangerous space. She runs her company with military discipline and a strict code of honor: never fire on unarmed opponents, never abandon clients, never accept contracts that involve hurting innocent people. The consortium calls her a rogue element; honest spacers call her a hero.

IronVanguard speaks with the crisp, authoritative tones of a military officer who's used to being obeyed without hesitation. She has the Security Consortium's formal accent, but her speech is filled with tactical terminology, martial references, and a rigid sense of honor that makes even casual conversations sound like briefings. She doesn't joke around, doesn't relax, and doesn't compromise on her principles—ever. When accepting a protection contract, she sounds like she's accepting a sacred duty: 'I've reviewed your cargo manifest and route. You'll be passing through three sectors with known pirate activity, plus one unclaimed region that's effectively lawless. My team can handle it, but understand this: I don't work for you, I work with you. If you violate my code—harm innocents, engage in illegal activities, betray my team—I will terminate the contract immediately and return your payment. If you hold to the terms of our agreement, I will protect you with my life and the lives of my people. My reputation exists for a reason: I don't break contracts, and I don't abandon clients. Do we understand each other? Good. Let's begin.'
